native_probe: The initial original-source probe checked dataset ownership during native admission after the owned journal existed but before root ownership was claimed. Read-only source verification now leaves DB ownership to native maintenance; normal registration/doctor/preparation/mutations keep the original check.
native_error_parser: Actual native errors have human-readable content plus typed structuredContent. Corrected verifier to use the actual typed error.
race_observation: One initial race execution of the existing absolute deadline test observed a late writer. Five repetitions before the code change did not reproduce it; no unique root cause is claimed.
boundary_strengthening: Check actual wall clock immediately before/after exec, independently of timer callback delivery; add a past-deadline no-exec test. Both boundary cases passed five race repetitions and the final full module and six-package race run passed sequentially.
